d:
Delhi Police has apprehended a 14-year-old boy from Ballabhgarh, Haryana, for allegedly hacking a website linked to Agniveer registrations and attempting to sell the personal data of around 4,000 Agniveers on the dark web for $500. Investigators are examining the recovered digital data and have sought an official database from the Ministry of Home Affairs to verify its authenticity. Police are also probing the suspected use of AI tools in the alleged hacking attempt.
